title: 3 Carn, Belturbet, Co. Cavan, H14DP60
description:
**FINAL VIEWING WEDNESDAY 9TH SEPTEMBER **

LWK are delighted to present this superb, detached 4-bedroom bungalow in the heart of Cavan Lakelands to the market for sale.

Meticulously maintained and thoughtfully enhanced, this bright and spacious property makes for an ideal family home. Located next to KiIdallagh Village, the local school, church and pub are a stone’s throw away, Belturbet and Ballyconnell are within striking distance and Cavan town is within a 15 minute drive.

The property briefly comprises: a bright dual aspect living room featuring a new solid fuel stove with marble surround, complete with back burner. A modernised kitchen features new countertops, splashback and Kitchen Island with updated kitchen units.  Patio doors then leading to the large south facing back garden . The property features a utility room, hotpress, guest WC and family bathroom plus four generous double bedrooms, to include a master bedroom en-suite. All rooms are well proportioned with ample storage. A special feature of this property is the spacious .8 acre site with immaculate wraparound lawns, complete with an insulated detached garage.

The interior and exterior of the property have been recently painted, the floors replaced with a combination of quality tiled and laminate flooring and the boiler was replaced in 2021.

Ideally situated within a cluster of family homes in the countryside, the nearby towns provide a good choice of creches, schools and restaurants, with a cinema, regional hospital and a host of amenities located in Cavan town. Castle Saunderson and the highly renowned Slieve Russell Hotel with 18-hole Golf Course are close by and the Cuilcagh Boardwalk/ Stairway to Heaven is approximately 20 minutes away - to name a few.  The peaceful rural surroundings all of which combine to create a truly attractive private home.
